sloka: निपेतुस्ते तु मेदिन्यां निकृत्ता इव किंशुकाः।तेषु वानरमुख्येषु पतितेषु महात्मसु।वानराणां सहस्राणि कुम्भकर्णं प्रदुद्रुवुः ।। ६.६७.३१ ।।
transliteration: nipetuste tu medinyāṁ nikṛttā iva kiṁśukāḥ।teṣu vānaramukhyeṣu patiteṣu mahātmasu।vānarāṇāṁ sahasrāṇi kumbhakarṇaṁ pradudruvuḥ ।। 6.67.31 ।।

translations.english: Angry Kumbhakarna (enemy of Indra) hit Sarabha with his fist, Neela with his knees hurt Gavaksha and slapped him with his palms. Gandhamadana was kicked with force.
